description: 描述主体为预防或减轻对自身劳动力负面影响而已采取、计划或正在进行的行动。

labels.en: Description of action taken, planned or underway to prevent or mitigate negative impacts on own workforce
labels.zh: 预防或减轻对自身劳动力负面影响的行动

description: 说明主体是否以及如何针对实际重大影响采取提供或促成补救的行动。

labels.en: Disclosure on whether and how action has been taken to provide or enable remedy in relation to actual material impact
labels.zh: 对实际重大影响提供或促成补救的行动

description: 描述以向自身劳动力传递积极影响为主要目的的其他举措或行动。

labels.en: Description of additional initiatives or actions with primary purpose of delivering positive impacts for own workforce
labels.zh: 为自身劳动力带来积极影响的其他举措

description: 说明主体如何跟踪和评估行动与举措在改善自身劳动力结果方面的有效性。

labels.en: Description of how effectiveness of actions and initiatives in delivering outcomes for own workforce is tracked and assessed
labels.zh: 行动与举措有效性的跟踪评估

description: 描述主体针对特定实际或潜在负面影响确定所需适当行动的流程。

labels.en: Description of process through which it identifies what action is needed and appropriate in response to particular actual or potential negative impact on own workforce
labels.zh: 确定所需行动的流程

description: 描述为缓解因对自身劳动力的影响和依赖所产生的重大风险而计划或正在进行的行动，以及有效性跟踪方式。

labels.en: Description of what action is planned or underway to mitigate material risks arising from impacts and dependencies on own workforce  and how effectiveness is tracked
labels.zh: 缓解自身劳动力重大风险的行动与有效性跟踪

description: 描述为把握与自身劳动力相关的重大机遇而计划或正在进行的行动。

labels.en: Description of what action is planned or underway to pursue material opportunities in relation to own workforce
labels.zh: 把握自身劳动力相关重大机遇的行动

description: 说明主体如何确保自身实践不会造成或促成对自身劳动力的重大负面影响。

labels.en: Disclosure of whether and how it is ensured that own practices do not cause or contribute to material negative impacts on own workforce
labels.zh: 确保自身实践不造成或促成负面影响的机制

description: 披露为管理重大影响所分配的资源，包括人员、预算和管理层投入。

labels.en: Disclosure of resources are allocated to the management of material impacts
labels.zh: 管理重大影响的资源分配

description: 披露主体处理重大负面影响所采用的总体方法和针对具体影响的专门方法。

labels.en: Disclosure of general and specific approaches to addressing material negative impacts
labels.zh: 处理重大负面影响的总体与具体方法

description: 披露主体旨在贡献额外重大积极影响的举措及其预期结果。

labels.en: Disclosure of initiatives aimed at contributing to additional material positive impacts
labels.zh: 贡献额外重大积极影响的举措

description: 说明报告期内主体在相关行动和举措上的进展程度。

labels.en: Disclosure of how far undertaking has progressed in efforts during reporting period
labels.zh: 报告期内的进展程度

description: 披露主体为持续改进设定的目标及其衡量方式。

labels.en: Disclosure of aims for continued improvement
labels.zh: 持续改进的目标

description: 说明主体是否以及如何利用与相关业务关系的杠杆来管理影响自身劳动力的重大负面影响。

labels.en: Disclosure of whether and how undertaking seeks to use leverage with relevant business relationships to manage material negative impacts affecting own workforce
labels.zh: 利用业务关系杠杆管理负面影响

description: 说明相关举措以及主体自身的参与如何针对所涉重大影响发挥作用。

labels.en: Disclosure of how the initiative, and its own involvement, is aiming to address the material impact concerned
labels.zh: 举措及主体参与如何应对重大影响

description: 说明员工和员工代表是否以及如何参与以积极影响为主要目的的项目或流程的设计与实施决策。

labels.en: Disclosure of whether and how workers and workers' representatives play role in decisions regarding design and implementation of programmes or processes whose primary aim is to deliver positive impacts for workers
labels.zh: 员工在设计实施积极影响项目中的参与

description: 提供针对自身劳动力的项目或流程的预期或已实现积极结果信息。

labels.en: Information about intended or achieved positive outcomes of programmes or processes for own workforce
labels.zh: 项目或流程的预期或已实现积极结果

description: 说明以积极影响员工为主要目的的项目或流程是否同时支持实现一项或多项可持续发展目标。

labels.en: Initiatives or processes whose primary aim is to deliver positive impacts for own workforce  are designed also to support achievement of one or more of Sustainable Development Goals
labels.zh: 项目与可持续发展目标的衔接

description: 提供为缓解绿色、气候中性经济转型对员工造成的负面影响所采取的措施。

labels.en: Information about measures taken to mitigate negative impacts on workers that arise from transition to greener, climate-neutral economy
labels.zh: 绿色低碳转型对员工负面影响的缓解措施

description: 描述参与影响管理的内部职能，以及这些职能为应对负面影响和推进积极影响所采取的行动类型。

labels.en: Description of internal functions that are involved in managing impacts and types of action taken by internal functions to address negative and advance positive impacts
labels.zh: 参与影响管理的内部职能及行动类型
